column2: Sìshí ge tài duō le, wǒ yào yíbàn ba.
column3: Forty is too many; I'll have half.

column2: Bàn jīn èrshí ge. Nín xiǎng hē shénme?
column3: Half a jin is twenty. What would you like to drink?

column2: Qǐng gěi wǒ yì bēi chá ba.
column3: A cup of tea, please.

column1: 你们上火车后看见王老师了吗？
column2: Nǐmen shàng huǒchē hòu kànjiàn Wáng lǎoshī le ma?
column3: Did you see Teacher Wang after you got on the train?

column1: 没看见。中午车开后，有些人在看书，有些人睡觉了。
column2: Méi kànjiàn. Zhōngwǔ chē kāi hòu, yǒuxiē rén zài kàn shū, yǒuxiē rén shuìjiào le.
column3: No. After the train left at noon, some people were reading and some went to sleep.

column2: Nǐ ne?
column3: And you?

column2: Wǒ kàn le yí ge diànyǐng.
column3: I watched a movie.

column1: 你们会说汉语了，也会写汉字了吗？
column2: Nǐmen huì shuō Hànyǔ le, yě huì xiě Hànzì le ma?
column3: You can speak Chinese now—can you write Chinese characters too?

column2: Wǒmen dōu huì xiě le.
column3: We can all write now.

column2: Lǎoshī, wǒ tīng bu jiàn.
column3: Teacher, I can't hear.

column1: 请大家不要说话！请听老师的问题：你们都会写哪些汉字了？
column2: Qǐng dàjiā bú yào shuōhuà! Qǐng tīng lǎoshī de wèntí: nǐmen dōu huì xiě nǎxiē Hànzì le?
column3: Everyone, please stop talking! Listen to the teacher's question: which characters can you all write now?

column2: Wǒ huì xiě zhèxiē zì le, nín kàn!
column3: I can write these characters now—look!

column2: Míngnián nǚ'ér shàng zhōngxué.
column3: Next year my daughter starts middle school.

column2: Duì. Érzi yě shàng xiǎoxué le.
column3: Right. My son has started elementary school too.

column1: 我们家有了一个中学生。
column2: Wǒmen jiā yǒu le yí ge zhōngxuéshēng.
column3: Our family now has a middle school student.

column2: Hái yǒu le yí ge xiǎoxuéshēng.
column3: And an elementary school student too.

column2: Shàngxué hòu, tāmen dōu máng le.
column3: Once school started, they both got busy.

column2: Shì de. Tài wǎn le, shuìjiào ba.
column3: Yes. It's too late; let's go to bed.

column2: Nǐmen ài chī nǎge cài?
column3: Which dish do you like?

column1: 我喜欢这个，也喜欢那个。
column2: Wǒ xǐhuan zhège, yě xǐhuan nàge.
column3: I like this one, and that one too.

column1: 这些菜都好吃，还很好看。
column2: Zhèxiē cài dōu hǎochī, hái hěn hǎokàn.
column3: These dishes are all delicious, and they look great too.

column1: 我爱吃中国菜，也喜欢做。大家多吃点儿。
column2: Wǒ ài chī Zhōngguó cài, yě xǐhuan zuò. Dàjiā duō chī diǎnr.
column3: I love Chinese food, and I like cooking it too. Everyone, help yourselves.

column2: Nǐmen dōu xiǎng qù nǎr?
column3: Where do you all want to go?

column1: 去年我和男朋友去了西安，今年我想去北京。
column2: Qùnián wǒ hé nánpéngyou qù le Xī'ān, jīnnián wǒ xiǎng qù Běijīng.
column3: Last year my boyfriend and I went to Xi'an; this year I want to go to Beijing.

column1: 前几年我去了西安，非常好玩儿。今年我也想去北京。
column2: Qián jǐ nián wǒ qù le Xī'ān, fēicháng hǎowánr. Jīnnián wǒ yě xiǎng qù Běijīng.
column3: A few years ago I went to Xi'an—it was great fun. This year I want to go to Beijing too.

column1: 我和王老师都是北京人，北京非常漂亮。
column2: Wǒ hé Wáng lǎoshī dōu shì Běijīngrén, Běijīng fēicháng piàoliang.
column3: Teacher Wang and I are both from Beijing; Beijing is very beautiful.

column1: 你们的飞机到北京要几个小时？
column2: Nǐmen de fēijī dào Běijīng yào jǐ ge xiǎoshí?
column3: How many hours does your flight to Beijing take?

column2: Jiǔ ge xiǎoshí.
column3: Nine hours.

column1: 我家人都在北京，星期天我姐姐也有时间，她可以去机场接你们，你们也可以住我家。
column2: Wǒ jiārén dōu zài Běijīng, xīngqītiān wǒ jiějie yě yǒu shíjiān, tā kěyǐ qù jīchǎng jiē nǐmen, nǐmen yě kěyǐ zhù wǒ jiā.
column3: My family is all in Beijing. My sister is free on Sunday too, so she can pick you up at the airport, and you can stay at my place.

column1: 我们星期日早上八点到大兴机场，早不早？
column2: Wǒmen xīngqīrì zǎoshang bā diǎn dào Dàxīng jīchǎng, zǎo bu zǎo?
column3: We arrive at Daxing Airport at 8 a.m. Sunday—is that early?

column2: Bù zǎo.
column3: Not early.

column1: 谢谢老师！那我们和您姐姐在大兴机场见！
column2: Xièxie lǎoshī! Nà wǒmen hé nín jiějie zài Dàxīng jīchǎng jiàn!
column3: Thank you, Teacher! Then we'll meet your sister at Daxing Airport!
